| `timeoutMs` | integer | 60000 | Watch"},{"id":"p28s2","text":" budget (max 600000 = 10 min) |
| `intervalMs` | integer | 1000 | Poll interval (min 250) |
| `withS"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"tacks` | boolean | true | Include same-pid stack lines per crash |
